Definition: properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble)
BiblicalUsage: To cry out is the verb of the oppressed and the prophet alike. Habakkuk cries how long shall I cry and thou wilt not hear, Job says the poor cried and he delivered them, and the oppressed cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty. Lamentations adds the hardest verse: also when I cry and shout, He shutteth out my prayer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe crying out is faith even when it feels unheard. Habakkuk cried, Job heard the poor cry, and I hold that God hears the cry He seems to shut out, because He heard it in the end.
